summary: One task of a round of the IO board component research (hardware/docs/Research.md)
logs: FU: 16 agents started (11 planned, 5 of 21 free used); 117 items for follow-up

items.requirement: Sized for about 49.7 A: the board's draw from the pack at the 6.0 V floor with the four TPS55285 at 6.35 A, nominal at an assumed 90 %. Round 1 sized both for 12.23 A (V90). No pack disconnect passed round 1: its one shortlisted candidate, R5460N212AF-TR-FE, failed the open balance lead (V107) in FU-B1, and FU-B3 found none. Answered under Raised by P1: V295: As V294: 3.3 V a cell under load is the lowest trip, the threshold set above it by the IC's accuracy band. V95's ±75 mV, round 1's R5460 figure, is no requirement (owner, 2026-10-02) V297: One IC does the pack disconnect, the pack overcurrent protection, the bench pack balance lead and the pack temperature, selected in FU-2F (owner, 2026-10-02) V301: 10 µA stays, with an operator wake contact for a start from the pack alone. The open-lead behaviour may rest on the IC's undervoltage logic, an inference. A bench test confirms it before the pages call V107 met: mid wire open, with and without a charger, and first cell attach (owner, 2026-10-02)
items.source: IOBoard.md, Pack path current and Pack reconnect; Supply.md, Not known

items.function: overvoltage protection; reverse-polarity protection; inrush limiting
items.requirement: The DC input's overvoltage threshold, non-destructive (owner, 2026-09-30): round 1 left the overvoltage protection without a part. FU-B3 did not requalify the LM74800QDRRRQ1 for the reverse-polarity protection and the inrush limiting. Answered under Raised by P1: V299: Yes, as a current limitation. After a trip, a source between the release, 18.58 to 19.81 V, and 20.0 V stays cut off until it falls below the release, and the board runs from the pack. The DC input range stays 12 to 20 V. Firmware does not take the DC input as selected because it is present (owner, 2026-10-02)
items.source: IOBoard.md, Overvoltage protection, Reverse-polarity protection, Inrush limiting, and Not known under Power
items.reason: requirement changed after round 1 or round 1 left the function without a part (Research.md, Round 2, Follow-ups)

items.requirement: A signal the coprocessor reads that tells the DC input from the pack: a DC-input-present input or the DC input voltage, on an RP2354B input or an expander pin within the pin budget. Answered under Raised by P1: V271: One signal: the DC input voltage through a divider into one ADC input of the measurement coprocessor, GPIO 40 to 47. The firmware compares it with the thresholds, so it serves the source status and the DC input brownout detection (owner, 2026-10-01) V276: As V271: the DC input voltage on one ADC input of the measurement coprocessor, serving both (owner, 2026-10-01) V300: The values stay. A one-point bench calibration sets the divider and the ADC on each board. The pages bound the trip and reset corners before the ADC's own error only (owner, 2026-10-02)
items.reason: requirement changed after round 1 or round 1 left the function without a part (Research.md, Round 2, Follow-ups)

items.requirement: Thresholds for about 49.7 A, against 3.0 V a cell (F9) and 0 to 55 °C (owner, 2026-09-30), at or below the pack's 90 A continuous. Round 1 set them for 12.23 A (V150). items.requirement: FU-2B1 refutes the SLS XTRON pack on its discharge floor and its temperature. The maker's safety notes (REV.1.06, section 4) set 3.3 V a cell under load and 3.75 V at rest; its guide makes preheating mandatory below 18 °C for loads above 5C (15 A). The board's floor is 3.3 V a cell, and below 18 °C the pack delivers 15 A or less (owner, 2026-10-02). Answered under Raised by P1: V294: 3.3 V a cell under load, 6.6 V for the pack; it replaces F9's 3.0 V. The protector's undervoltage threshold sits above 3.3 V by its accuracy band, so 3.3 V is the lowest trip. The pack path stays sized at 6.0 V: 52.1 A nominal at a 5.8 V bus, rated 60 A (owner, 2026-10-02) V296: Below 18 °C at the pack's NTC, firmware lowers the TPS55285 current limits so the pack delivers 15 A or less (90 W at 6.0 V). The DC input keeps its full power. No part of its own (owner, 2026-10-02)
items.source: V294, V296; FU-2B1, R7 adjudicator ruling 015
items.reason: requirement changed after round 1 or round 1 left the function without a part (Research.md, Round 2, Follow-ups)

items.function: input transient clamp (TVS on the DC input and on the pack input)
items.requirement: No part in FU-2B1; P2 returned no entry for it. The reverse-polarity protection, the overvoltage protection, the inrush limiting and the source selection survive 60 V for 10 µs only behind the clamp: TVS2701DRBR clamps to 35.7 V at 27 °C and 37.3 V at 125 °C. The clamp is the power input's protection, researched in stage 1, with TVS2701DRBR as its first candidate (owner, 2026-10-02). Behind the overvoltage cut-off the bus sees the clamp voltage for 3.98 µs typical, 5.4 µs maximum, plus the MOSFETs' gate-discharge time, against the TPS55285's 27 V absolute maximum
items.source: FU-2B1, R5 P2 report and P4 checks

value.quantity: pack full-charge voltage used for sizing (V, upper bound)
value.refutation_tried: checked the SLS XTRON vendor-page description at IOBoard.md:395 -- it states 7.4 V nominal and no per-cell charge limit, so 4.2 V/cell is not vendor-confirmed; already raised as V92 ('for research'), not re-raised

value.quantity: board draw from the pack at the 6.0 V floor, nominal (A)
value.refutation_tried: recomputed the four-converter subtotal from the page's own per-converter figures: 3 servo converters at 9.9 A each (IOBoard.md:359) = 29.7 A, plus the adjustable supply at 17.6 A (IOBoard.md:381) = 47.3 A, matching the stated four-converter figure exactly; adding the display's 1.4 A (IOBoard.md:395) and the second RP2354B's 0.2 A (IOBoard.md:120) gives 48.9 A, about 0.8 A short of the stated 49.7 A, with the remainder (the main RP2354B's and other unitemized logic current) not broken out anywhere in the tree; the underlying 90% pack-side efficiency is explicitly 'not stated' and remains open at V90/V105/V111 ('for research')

value.quantity: stated failure reasons of the pack disconnect candidates
value.value: each candidate failed an open balance lead (V107), the reconnect condition (V93, V94) or the per-cell floor (V95)
value.refutation_tried: read every P2, P3, rerank and P4 return for R5's pack disconnect across T3, FU-B1 and FU-B3 -- only one candidate was ever shortlisted, R5460N212AF-TR-FE, refuted in both FU-B1 (hardware/research/round1/FU-B1/032-P4-datasheet-R5.json) and FU-B3 specifically on the balance-lead-open check (V107); the same P4 return shows it passing the reconnect-condition (V93, V94) and per-cell-floor (V95) checks. No candidate's recorded failure is the reconnect condition or the per-cell floor; the claim is not supported by the primary files read for this task

value.quantity: nominal board draw from the pack at the 6.0 V floor
value.value: about 49.7 A with the display, the logic rails and the second RP2354B included; about 47.3 A from the four TPS55285 converters alone at an assumed 90 % efficiency
value.source: IOBoard.md:359 (Pack path current): 'at the 6.0 V floor the four converters at 6.35 A draw about 47.3 A at an assumed 90 %, and the board about 49.7 A ... nominal figures'.
value.refutation_tried: The page itself calls these 'nominal figures' with 'no upper bound' until the protection threshold is set (IOBoard.md:395). The 90 % efficiency from the pack is unverified (already raised as V140, Research.md:836, 'for research'); not re-raised here. Holds as the nominal, not maximum, draw this follow-up's threshold has to clear.

value.quantity: charger efficiency and resulting charge current
value.value: assumed 90 %: 13.5 W, about 1.6 A into a full pack at 8.4 V; a 2 A charger (BQ25887 reference figure) uses the whole 13.5 W above 6.75 V
value.source: IOBoard.md:400 (Charge current): 'At an assumed 90 % that is 13.5 W ...'.
value.refutation_tried: No source is given for 90 %; the same unverified figure as V139 (Research.md:835, 'for research'), already under Raised by P1 and not re-raised. The arithmetic (15 W x 0.9 = 13.5 W; 13.5 W / 8.4 V = 1.607 A) holds.

value.value: not stated: whether it is the RP2354B's own USB port or a separate USB-C connector
value.source: IOBoard.md:407 (Not known): 'Whether the charger's USB-C input is the RP2354B's USB port or a connector of its own: not stated (F8, R7, round 2)'.
value.refutation_tried: Matches V148 (Research.md:844, 'for research'), already under Raised by P1; not re-raised here.

SLS safety notes REV.1.06 section 3: 'Voll geladen beträgt die Spannung 12,6 V (4,2 V pro Zelle)' (3S example at 3,7 V a cell nominal); section 1: the 'Nenn-/Ladeschlussspannung' is not to be exceeded. The vendor page states only 'Spannung: 7,4V (2S)'
found_values.source: https://www.stefansliposhop.de/media/general/SLS_Sicherheitshinweise_DE_A4.pdf sections 1 and 3 (vendors.py fetch, HTTP 200, 509,128 bytes); https://www.stefansliposhop.de/akkus/sls-xtron/sls-xtron-30c/sls-xtron-3000mah-2s1p-7-4v-30c-60c::1031.html (HTTP 200)

found_values.value: 94.7 % typical, a graph reading: BQ25723 Figure 8-1 (VIN 5 V, CCM 800 kHz, RAC = RSR = 5 mOhm, 2.2 uH), curve VOUT 7.4 V: about 94.8 % from 1.7 to 2.0 A and about 94.5 % at 2.2 A (page 21 rendered at 300 dpi). No curve at 6.6 V or 8.4 V and no guaranteed figure. Replaces the assumed 90 %
found_values.source: https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/bq25723.pdf SLUSE64 (May 2021) 8.7 Figure 8-1 (vendors.py fetch, HTTP 200, 4,002,198 bytes)

found_values.value: About 88.5 % typical (88 to 89 %), a graph reading: TPS55285 Figure 5-3 (VOUT 9 V, FPWM, TA 25 °C), curve VIN 5 V at its last point near 4 A (page 9 rendered at 250 dpi). No curve at 6.0 V in, 8.4 V and 6.35 A out, and the datasheet guarantees no efficiency. IOBoard.md's about 49.7 A and V294's 52.1 A use an assumed 90 %, which stays the nominal sizing basis (Research.md, Round 2, Rules of stage 1)
found_values.source: https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps55285.pdf SLVSI72A 5.6 Figure 5-3 (vendors.py fetch, HTTP 200, 4,317,800 bytes)

found_values.value: About 96 % typical, a graph reading: TPS62933F Figure 8-22 (VOUT 5 V, 500 kHz, 6.8 uH), curve Vin 6 V at 1.5 A (page 12 rendered at 250 dpi). 7.5 W / 0.96 / 6.0 V = 1.30 A from the pack (computed)
found_values.source: https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps62933.pdf SLUSEA4D Figure 8-22 (vendors.py fetch, HTTP 200, 4,034,940 bytes)

found_values.value: 84.6 mA average a cell: the pack maker's guide, 'Ein effizienter Balancer sollte eigentlich 1/20 des Ladestroms zum Ausgleichen der einzelnen Zellen schaffen'; 1/20 of the 1.69 A charge current into a full pack (V144) is 84.6 mA (computed). The guide starts balancing at the CC to CV transition, 4.0 or 4.1 V a cell
found_values.source: https://www.stefansliposhop.de/media/general/LiPoFAQV15c.pdf, 'Das Balancen' (vendors.py fetch, HTTP 200, 470,473 bytes), linked from the safety notes section 4

found_values.value: About 1.18 A at 6.0 V (computed): the 3.3 V rail at its 1,475 mA summed maxima, 5.4 W in, and the encoder supply, 1.3 W in, (5.4 + 1.3) W / 6.0 V = 1.12 A, plus the load-cell excitation's 0.06 A linear from the bus. V294's 52.1 A at a 5.8 V bus already includes them
found_values.source: /home/claude/rcbench-research/round2/results/hardware/research/round2/FU-2B1/003-P2-R5.json, found value V90 (its sources: IOBoard.md Pack path current and Adjustable supply budget, R5 report '3.3 V rail load, summed maxima')

found_values.value: 1.69 A into a full pack at 8.4 V: 15 W (F8) x 94.7 % (V139) = 14.2 W, / 8.4 V = 1.691 A; 2.15 A at the 6.6 V floor of V294 (computed). The 3 A input limit sets the rate across 6.6 to 8.4 V; the BQ25723 sets up to 16.256 A in 128 mA steps with a 5 mOhm RSR. Below VSYS_MIN with 2S it clamps the charge to 384 mA
found_values.source: F8 answer; V139 above; https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/bq25723.pdf SLUSE64 Features and 8.5 (pre-charge clamp)

found_values.value: 3000 mAh for the pack, 2S1P, so 3000 mAh a cell, as the vendor page states. No source states a minimum capacity or run time. At 52.1 A nominal the pack runs about 3.5 min from full (3.0 Ah / 52.1 A, no rate derating), 2.8 min at the maker's limit of 80 % use (computed)
found_values.source: https://www.stefansliposhop.de/akkus/sls-xtron/sls-xtron-30c/sls-xtron-3000mah-2s1p-7-4v-30c-60c::1031.html 'Kapazität: 3000mAh'; LiPoFAQV15c.pdf 'Nutzung von über 80% der Nennkapazität ist nicht sinnvoll'

found_values.value: Charge: the maker's guide allows fast charge from 10 °C ('minimal 10°C') to 40 °C ('max. 40°C'), under 10 °C below 1C (typically 0.2C to 0.5C), and a reduced current from 15 °C; the board charges at 0.56C to 0.72C (1.69 to 2.15 A on 3.0 Ah). Discharge: the pack never above 60 °C; below 18 °C loads above 5C need preheating, which V296 meets by 15 A or less. The board's ambient is 0 to 50 °C (V7) and the owner's pack limits are 0 to 55 °C (V150)
found_values.source: https://www.stefansliposhop.de/media/general/LiPoFAQV15c.pdf sections 'Laden wenn der LiPo sehr kalt oder warm ist', 'Woran erkennt man', 'Und wenn es mal kalt (unter 18°C) wird?', 'Die maximale Leistung'; Research.md V7, V150, V296 at 267fcc6

found_values.value: The RP2354B's USB port: one USB Type-C connector carries the F8 charger input, the RP2354B's D+ and D-, and CC1 and CC2, VBUS rated 5.5 V at 3 A. It has no SuperSpeed pair, so the Default current the CC detector applies is 500 mA (USB 2.0)
found_values.source: hardware/docs/Research.md V10 and V13 answers (owner, 2026-09-28), checkout 267fcc6db3edc0a57f770a64679d22e8e2d8afee

found_values.value: On the IO board, as an LCSC part JLCPCB places. The SLS safety notes section 2: 'SLS Akkus verfügen über keine eigene Schutzschaltung', so the pack as sold has no protection; it is bought assembled at Stefansliposhop, not at Digi-Key, and its XH balance lead reaches the board (IOBoard.md Bench pack balance lead)
found_values.source: https://www.stefansliposhop.de/media/general/SLS_Sicherheitshinweise_DE_A4.pdf section 2; IOBoard.md Pack overcurrent protection at 267fcc6

found_values.value: Owner: over-temperature 55 °C and under-temperature 0 °C (2026-09-30). Found: per-cell overvoltage on charge at 4.25 V, 50 mV above the 4.2 V a cell full charge of the maker's notes and above the charger's 8.4 V setting, whose +0.6 % edge is 4.2252 V a cell. Short circuit: a trip band, with the part's stated tolerance, above the overcurrent band and at or below the pack's 60C (180 A) burst, whose duration the vendor does not state
found_values.source: SLS_Sicherheitshinweise_DE_A4.pdf section 3; vendor page 'Kurzzeitiger Entladestrom: max. 60C (180,0A)'; bq25723.pdf SLUSE64 8.5 VBAT_REG_ACC

found_values.value: Yes, up to the 3.0 A input limit at 5 V (15 W) less the charge current. The BQ25723's NVDC path regulates VSYS at the VSYS_MIN setting, 6.6 V by default for 2S (Table 9-2), with a depleted battery ('Even with a depleted battery, the system is regulated above the minimum system voltage', 9.4.1.1). The servo converters' draw far exceeds 15 W, so firmware limits them on USB alone
found_values.source: https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/bq25723.pdf SLUSE64 9.3.8 Table 9-2, 9.4.1.1, pin BATDRV

found_values.value: Yes: USB-C is the only charge source (F8), so a pack at the floor recovers on the bench only by charging while the floor disconnect holds discharge off. With the BQ40Z80 as the one protector, CUV sets OperationStatus()[XDSG] only, charging stays allowed, and with Protection Configuration[CUV_RECOV_CHG] = 1 the CUV recovers only when charging is detected and every cell is at or above CUV:Recovery. The charger connects on the pack side of the protector's FETs
found_values.source: https://www.ti.com/lit/pdf/sluubt5 SLUUBT5C 3.2 Cell Undervoltage Protection (vendors.py fetch, HTTP 200, 4,683,293 bytes); F8 answer

BQ40Z80 AOLD 0x08, 61.08 mV, 1 mOhm shunt: nominal 61.1 A; 52.5 to 69.7 A with the datasheet's no-trim +-10 % and +-2.5 mV, 55.5 to 66.6 A post-trim (+-5 %). The datasheet does not say which applies to a shipped part. The lower edge is 0.4 A above 52.1 A before the shunt's tolerance: a shunt 0.7 % low brings it under 52.1 A on the no-trim figures. Delay 1 to 31 ms plus 160 us detect

The BQ40Z80 datasheet states no cell-voltage accuracy. Without board calibration: K 0.198 to 0.202 (33 mV at 3.3 V), ADC gain error 0.8 % of full scale (49 mV at the cell if full scale is 1.225 V, 98 mV if 2.45 V), offset 0.8 mV: 83 to 132 mV. CUV:Threshold 3390 to 3440 mV holds the 3.3 V lowest trip. The same band puts a 4.25 V COV as low as 4.12 to 4.17 V, under the 4.2 V full charge, so per-board voltage calibration, which the datasheet requires before gauging, is needed for COV. Calibrated accuracy is not stated
report.source: SLUSBV4D 5.5 ADC and K rows, 7.3.1; computed

report.value: CUV:Delay is set in whole seconds (0 to 255 s, default 2 s). A sag below 3.3 V shorter than the delay is not stopped, against the maker's 'auch nicht kurzzeitig' (not even briefly)

report.value: BQ25723: one P-channel BATFET carries the pack current, 52.1 A continuous and 69.7 A briefly, driven 10 V below VSYS but limited by VSYS of 5.8 to 6.6 V at the floor, Ciss under 5 nF advised; drain-source at least the 12 V 2S SYSOVP. Whether one such P-channel FET carries 52.1 A at a 6 V gate drive is not known. Four N-channel switching FETs: input side at least VBUS 5.5 V, output side at least 12 V, about 3 A

report.figure: charger battery path loss and drop
report.value: The 5 mOhm RSR is in the pack-to-load path: 0.261 V and 13.6 W at 52.1 A, 0.349 V at 69.7 A, 0.501 V at the 100.2 A short-circuit edge, over the 0.5 V SRP-SRN absolute maximum for up to 1 ms. With the 1 mOhm protector shunt the two resistors drop 0.313 V at 52.1 A, more than the 0.2 V from a 6.0 V pack to the 5.8 V bus of V294 and within the 0.8 V from the 6.6 V floor. LTC4020 at 4 mOhm: 0.208 V, 10.9 W; 0.401 V at 100.2 A against its 0.3 V CSP-CSN maximum
94.7 % typical from 5 V into 7.4 V (V139). 1.69 A into 8.4 V and 2.15 A into 6.6 V from 15 W; 0.56C to 0.72C

report.value: BQ25723 at 8.4 V: 8.3496 to 8.4504 V (+-0.6 %, 0 to 85 °C), 4.2252 V a cell at the upper edge, 25 mV over the maker's 'nicht überschreiten'. A setting of 8.352 V keeps the edge at 8.402 V if the +-0.6 % holds there; the datasheet tabulates it at 8.4 V and 4.2 V only

V296's 15 A below 18 °C is 5C on 3.0 Ah, the maker's limit for loads without preheating; near 10 °C the maker's limit is under 15C (45 A). The maker states no rate between 0 and 10 °C
BQ40Z80 SMBus 0x16 8-bit (0x0B 7-bit), 100 kHz, XL 400 kHz, inputs to 32 V; BQ25723 I2C 0x6B; FUSB303B 0x21 or 0x31 (ADDR/ORIENT)

report.value: BQ40Z80 ships configured for 6S: the first power-up on a 2S pack needs a supply on PACK+ until the cell configuration is written, then a data-flash image (cell count, thresholds, Scale Factor 2 for currents above 32,767 mA, thermistor polynomial, FET Options[OTFET] = 1, CUV_RECOV_CHG = 1) and a calibration per board. Shutdown current 1.4 uA typical, no maximum stated, against V301's 10 uA

Pack charger and Power path: BQ25723RSNR (none in FU-2B1). Pack overcurrent protection and Bench pack balance lead: MAX17320G22+ to BQ40Z80RSMR. Pack temperature: BQ40Z80RSMR (none). Pack cells: the SLS XTRON pack now passes. Cell balancing stays BQ29209DRBR, Charger input limit stays FUSB303BTMX

This task found Type_C1, Type_C2, 2 x AO3401, 2 x LTVS16H5.0ET5G and TJA1051T/3 in the schematic text; the net tie itself is FU-B1's tracing (confirmed by FU-B1 P4 and by FU-2B1 adjudicator-R5-3), not re-traced, because text extraction carries no wiring. found_values.value: 2.5 A nominal. TPS25947 ILIM is +/-10 % above 1 A by its Features list; its table row at RILM 1.65 kOhm is 1.800 / 2.028 / 2.200 A, -10.9 % / +8.9 % of the formula 3334 / RILM, which applied to 2.5 A gives 2.23 A to 2.72 A. found_values.value: 25.2 V continuous without damage: the V267 answer names a 6S pack (6 x 4.2 V) or a 24 V supply; connected the right way round they give 25.2 V forward. A supply set above 25.2 V is not covered

found_values.value: The DC input's cut-off trips above 20.0 V and at or below 22.0 V (the TPS55285's highest recommended input) at every tolerance corner; 20 V is taken to include the source's own tolerance. With the LM7480x OV comparator, V(OVR) 1.195 to 1.267 V, and a divider of 17.06 with 0.1 % resistors it trips at 20.35 V to 21.66 V. It releases below V(OVF) 1.091 to 1.159 V: 18.58 V to 19.81 V, which V299 accepts as a current limitation
found_values.source: https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/lm7480-q1.pdf SNOSD95C 7.5 V(OVR), V(OVF); Research.md V299 Answer (owner, 2026-10-02)

found_values.value: 60 V for 10 us at the DC input terminals before any clamp: Application Note 88 Table 1 measures 57.2 V with a 24 V step, 1 uH lead and 10 uF ceramic (2.38 times the step); applied to V83's 25.2 V that is 60 V; the half period of 1 uH and 10 uF is 9.9 us. The source states voltages only, no current
found_values.source: https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/application-notes/an88f.pdf Table 1 (vendors.py fetch --client safari)

found_values.value: Yes: the reverse-polarity, overvoltage and inrush protection sit on the 2S pack input as well as on the DC input. A 6S pack on the 2S XT60 is the same mis-connection V267 names for the DC input; applying V267 to the pack input is an inference. One LM7480x controller on each input gives all three with the ideal-diode OR of the source selection
found_values.source: Research.md V267 Answer; IOBoard.md Reverse-polarity and Overvoltage protection rows; lm7480-q1.pdf SNOSD95C 9.5.1

found_values.value: 2.0 A peak on each input at plug-in, at every tolerance corner. No source in the tree states a limit; 2.0 A, the display's own 2 A peak (prerequisite 7), is the chosen bound. I_INRUSH = I(HGATE) x C_OUT / CdVdT with I(HGATE) source 39 to 75 uA: a design at 1.16 A nominal stays at or under 2.0 A with CdVdT -5 % and C_OUT +20 %
found_values.source: lm7480-q1.pdf SNOSD95C 7.5 I(HGATE) source, 9.3.2.2; Research.md prerequisite 7

found_values.value: The DC input counts as absent below 10.1 V falling and present above 11.0 V rising, set by the LM7480x EN/UVLO comparator (V(UVLOR) 1.195 to 1.267 V, V(UVLOF) 1.091 to 1.159 V) with a divider of 8.936: falling 9.73 V to 10.38 V, rising 10.66 V to 11.34 V with 0.1 % resistors. The falling threshold's lowest corner stays above the pack's highest 8.45 V; 12 V is taken as the lowest the DC source delivers with its tolerance
found_values.source: lm7480-q1.pdf SNOSD95C 7.5; V92 found

found_values.value: 0 ms on the 3.3 V and 5 V rails: a 3.3 V dip resets the RP2354B and the F12 supervisor, a 5 V dip resets the display. The ideal-diode OR keeps the bus up: on DC removal the pack path's MOSFET body diode conducts at once and DGATE turns on in 2.8 us typical, 3.8 us maximum; on DC connection the pack path's DGATE turns off in 0.5 us typical, 0.875 us maximum
found_values.source: lm7480-q1.pdf SNOSD95C 7.6 tDGATE_ON(dly), tDGATE_OFF(dly)

found_values.value: 52.1 A nominal at a 5.8 V bus, rated 60 A (V294, owner, 2026-10-02): the four TPS55285 at 6.35 A deliver 255.3 W, 283.7 W in at 90 %; with the 5 V rail at 2.08 A peak (11.6 W in), the 3.3 V rail at 1,475 mA (5.4 W in) and the encoder supply (1.3 W in), 302.0 W in, 50.4 A at 6.0 V and 52.1 A at 5.8 V. The TPS55285 states no efficiency and no ILIM_AVG maximum, so option 2 has no datasheet figure

found_values.value: Yes. The RP2354B's USB port and the F8 charger input share one USB Type-C connector (V10, V13: 5.5 V, 3 A). R7's NVDC charger holds VSYS at MinSystemVoltage, 6.144 V for 2S by default (BQ25713 REG0x0D/0C), with no battery or a depleted one; VSYS is R5's pack input, so every rail the pack path feeds runs from USB-C within the source's advertised current. R5 adds no part. R7 reselects its charger in FU-2F; a charger without an NVDC path changes this value
found_values.source: Research.md V10, V13 Answers; https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/bq25713.pdf MinSystemVoltage default 2S 6.144 V

found_values.value: 8.4 V nominal full charge (4.2 V a cell): the pack maker's safety notes state 4.2 V a cell fully charged (section 3). R5 designs the pack path to 8.45 V: a charger of the BQ25713 class regulates 8.4 V +/-0.6 % over 0 to 85 degC
found_values.source: https://www.stefansliposhop.de/media/general/SLS_Sicherheitshinweise_DE_A4.pdf REV.1.06 section 3 ('Voll geladen ... 4,2 V pro Zelle'); bq25713.pdf VBAT_REG_ACC at REG0x05/04 = 0x20D0 (8.4 V) -0.6 % to 0.6 %

found_values.value: The USB-C charger present (charging detected), and then every cell at or above V94's release voltage. The load returning alone never reconnects the pack (IOBoard.md Pack disconnect hysteresis), and the DC input does not, since it never charges the pack (F8). An operator wake contact restarts the IC from the pack alone (V301); a cell under the trip then trips again
found_values.source: IOBoard.md Pack disconnect hysteresis row; F8 and V301 Answers

found_values.value: 3.75 V a cell, the maker's lowest voltage at rest ('Im Ruhezustand sollte die Spannung pro Zelle nicht unter 3,75 V fallen'); its guide gives 3.70 V. 0.45 V above the 3.3 V floor under load. This replaces round 1's 3.2 V, which rested on the 3.0 V floor and the R5460 class
found_values.source: SLS_Sicherheitshinweise_DE_A4.pdf REV.1.06 section 4; https://www.stefansliposhop.de/media/general/LiPoFAQV15c.pdf 'Zusammenfassend'

found_values.value: Answered by V295: 3.3 V a cell under load is the lowest trip at every tolerance corner; the nominal threshold sits above it by the selected IC's accuracy band. For BQ40Z80RSMR the band at 3.3 V is +/-83 mV (K +/-1 %, gain error 0.8 % of FSR with FSR = VFS 1.225 V, offset 157 uV / K) or +/-132 mV if FSR spans -VFS to +VFS; threshold 3,383 mV or 3,432 mV. The figures hold over -40 to 85 degC; no figure bounds 0 to 50 degC alone
found_values.source: Research.md V294, V295 Answers; https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/bq40z80.pdf SLUSBV4D 5.5 (K, GE, OE)

found_values.value: No source sets a lower bound. The maker forbids a cell under 3.3 V under load 'auch nicht kurzzeitig' (not even briefly), so the filter has an upper bound: the cell must not fall from the set threshold to 3.3 V within it. That fall rate is not known (the pack's internal resistance is not measured, V285). Taken: the shortest delay the IC allows, stated with its granularity, recorded for P5
found_values.source: LiPoFAQV15c.pdf 'Zusammenfassend'; Research.md V285

BQ40Z80RSMR for the pack disconnect, the pack overcurrent protection, the bench pack balance lead and the pack temperature (V297). MAX17320G22+ is dropped: a charger releases every discharge-only fault, so it cannot hold the pack off with an open mid wire and a charger, or block discharge above 55 degC with a charger present. BQ29209DRBR, R7's balancer, sits on the same taps; P5 checks the two on the taps

BQ40Z80RSMR: CUV:Threshold 3432 mV (3383 mV under the narrower FSR reading), CUV:Recovery 3750 mV, CUV_RECOV_CHG = 1, CUV:Delay 0 s (average trigger up to 1.5 s), voltage-based shutdown at the floor, OCD (hardware) 61.08 mV on 1 mOhm or 33.36 mV on 0.5 mOhm, SCD1 111.0 mV on 1 mOhm, firmware OCD1 and OCD2 disabled (their mA field ends at 32.767 A), COV per R7 (4.25 V), OTC/OTD 55 degC, UTC/UTD 0 degC, cell temperature coefficients for the 10 kOhm B 3435 K NTC, 2S cell configuration. Written once over SMBus in production; the tree has none

report.figure: pack IC overcurrent and short-circuit bands
report.value: 1 mOhm: OCD 55.5 to 66.6 A, SCD1 103.0 to 119.1 A; 0.5 mOhm: OCD 58.4 to 75.1 A. Both above 52.1 A and at or below 90 A and 180 A, before the shunt's own tolerance

+/-83 mV at 3.3 V (K +/-1 %, GE 0.8 % of 1.225 V FSR, OE 157 uV) or +/-132 mV if FSR spans +/-VFS; over -40 to 85 degC; a Cell Gain calibration narrows it, no figure bounds the residue. Nominal trip 3.38 to 3.43 V above the 3.3 V lowest trip

report.figure: pack IC trip delay and the maker's floor
report.value: CUV delay setting 0 to 255 s in 1 s steps averages the setting plus up to 1.5 s; the maker forbids under 3.3 V under load even briefly. The cell's fall from the threshold in that time at 52 A is not known (internal resistance not measured, V285); the bench test of V301 can measure it

about 7.6 uA from the pack: ISHUTDOWN 1.4 uA typical (no maximum), VC leakage 1 uA max x 2, a 1 MOhm mid-cell pull-down up to 4.2 uA; TVS2701 leakage 30 nA max at 27 degC. R7's balancer on the same taps is not in it. Against 10 uA (V301)

report.figure: pack IC open-lead and first attach
report.value: V107 rests on the CUV logic with a mid-cell pull-down of 1 MOhm or less (an inference V301 allows); after a SHUTDOWN exit the IC fully resets and re-detects CUV only after the delay, so the pack may feed the bus for up to about 1.5 s on a wake or first attach: not stated in the documents; the bench test covers both

report.figure: pack IC pin ratings against the clamp
report.value: BQ40Z80 BAT, VCC, PBI, PACK, SMBC, SMBD 35 V absolute, 32 V recommended, with a 50 Ohm or larger series resistor needed above 28 V; the pack input's clamp reaches 37.3 V, so those pins take the series resistor. BQ40Z50-R2 and BQ4050: 30 V absolute
BQ40Z80 SMBus address 0x16 (8-bit, 0x0B 7-bit) by default, programmable in data flash; SMBus v1.1, 100 kHz. For P5's I2C address map

report.figure: clamp level against the bus parts

Below that level: TPS55285 VIN 27 V absolute, TPS62933 VIN 32 V absolute. Above it: LMQ66430 42 V, TPS55288 40 V, LM74800 70 V. OV rising to HGATE low 3.98 us typical, 5.4 us maximum; HGATE sink 168 mA minimum; release 18.58 to 19.81 V (accepted, V299). No LM7480x divider trips at or below 22.0 V and releases above 20.0 V (1.267 / 1.091 = 1.16)

Requirements for the MOSFETs R5's controllers drive (stage 2, owner 2026-10-02). LM74800 DC path, back-to-back N-channel: VDS >= 40 V (37.3 V clamp; -25.2 V reversed), 25.2 A continuous and 31.1 A at the handover; HGATE FET SOA for the 2.0 A inrush at up to 22 V across it. LM74800 pack path: VDS >= 40 V, 52.1 A continuous, 60 A rated, body diode 52.1 A for up to 3.8 us (tDGATE_ON) at each switchover. BQ40Z80 CHG and DSG, high-side back-to-back: VDS >= 40 V on the pack side, 60 A continuous, SOA for the SCD1 trip at up to 119 A for 0 to 915 us plus turn-off, DSG body diode carries charge current (about 1.6 A) while CUV holds DSG off

0.2 V from the cells to the converters at 52.1 A, 3.8 mOhm in all: the protector's two MOSFETs, the pack-path ideal-diode's two, the sense shunt (1 mOhm takes 52 mV, 0.5 mOhm 26 mV), the XT60 and the wiring. For P5 and stage 2

P2 dropped it for 'a part and MOSFET of their own where rank 1 needs none', which does not hold (see exclusions). Datasheet Rev. B (ltc4365.pdf, read 2026-10-02T16:08:31Z), Applications 'Limiting Inrush Current During Turn-On': GATE is pulled up by IGATE(UP) 12 to 30 uA (20 uA typical, 'GATE = VIN = VOUT = 12 V'); a capacitor CGATE from GATE to ground sets the slew, and the source follower gives IINRUSH = C_OUT / CGATE x IGATE(UP). data.ruling: The refutation stands. The figures in the claim reproduce from the sources. The sentence about the shunt has the wrong direction. The trip current is V_trip / R_shunt. With a shunt below nominal, the trip current rises (52.84 A at 0.993 mOhm, so the lower edge moves away from 52.1 A). Only a shunt above nominal lowers it. Also, 0.7 % high is not quite enough: 52.472 mV / 1.007 mOhm = 52.107 A, still 0.007 A above 52.1 A. The lower edge goes under 52.1 A at about +0.714 % (52.472 / 52.1 = 1.00714). The figure has to be corrected before it goes to the owner or P5. Correction: on the no-trim figures, a shunt about 0.71 % or more above nominal brings the AOLD lower edge under 52.1 A. The scope is this function, because the error concerns the overcurrent window against the pack path's 52.1 A nominal (V294). It is not a fault of the BQ40Z80 as a part.
data.evidence: Re-read 2026-10-02T16:44Z. SLUUBT5C Table A-2 (OLD Threshold, RSNS = 1): 0x08 = -61.08 mV. Table A-3: OLD delay ranges from 1 ms (0x00) to 31 ms (0x0F). BQ40Z80 datasheet SLUSBV4D (revised May 2026), section 5.5: VOFFSET for OCD, SCC and SCDx is -2.5 to +2.5 mV post-trim, and VSCALE is -10 % to +10 % with no trim and -5 % to +5 % post-trim. The datasheet labels these rows "OCD, SCC, and SCDx", not OLD by name. tDETECT is 160 us max. Recomputed at 1 mOhm: no-trim window 61.08 x 0.9 - 2.5 = 52.472 mV and 61.08 x 1.1 + 2.5 = 69.688 mV, so 52.47 to 69.69 A. Post-trim window 55.53 to 66.63 A. 52.472 / 1.007 = 52.107 A. 52.472 / 0.993 = 52.842 A. Break-even shunt factor 52.472 / 52.1 = 1.00714. Requirement: Research.md V294 Answer (owner, 2026-10-02) puts the pack path at 52.1 A nominal at a 5.8 V bus, rated 60 A. The claim says "a shunt 0.7 % low brings it under 52.1 A"; with I = V/R, a low shunt raises the trip current.

data.ruling: The refutation stands. The datasheet confirms the input value: in SLUSBV4D section 5.5, RNTC(PU) on TS1 to TS4 is 14.4 kOhm min, 18 kOhm typ and 21.6 kOhm max. Nothing marks it as trimmed. With that pull-up and the specified 10 kOhm, B 3435 K NTC, the reading error is not symmetric. Firmware reads the NTC against the nominal 18 kOhm, so the resistance it infers is R_NTC x 18/R_PU. At R_PU = 14.4 kOhm the reading is too cold by 4.76 K at 0 °C, 5.40 K at 18 °C and 6.85 K at 55 °C. At R_PU = 21.6 kOhm it is too warm by 4.02 K, 4.57 K and 5.82 K. The report's "+-4.0, +-4.5, +-5.7 K" matches only the positive side. It understates the cold-reading side by 0.8 to 1.2 K. That is the side that matters for the 55 °C upper limit: a reading of 55 °C occurs at 62.15 °C actual, about 7 K above the owner's 55 °C limit. The verifier wrote about 61.9 °C, which does not change the outcome. The report's second figure holds: after a one-point offset calibration at 25 °C, the residual is +0.90/-0.78 K at 0 °C and -1.18/+1.02 K at 55 °C, so "about 1 K" is reproduced. The uncalibrated band has to be restated as -4.8/+4.0 K at 0 °C, -5.4/+4.6 K at 18 °C and -6.9/+5.8 K at 55 °C. Not included in these figures: RNTC(DRIFT), -360 to -200 ppm/°C. Scope is function: the error is in a figure this function reports. Nothing about the BQ40Z80 part itself fails.

The NTC is from IOBoard.md, Pack temperature row: 10 kOhm, B 3435 K, limits 0 and 55 °C. Recomputed with R(T) = 10k*exp(B(1/T - 1/298.15)) and inferred R = R*18k/R_PU. data.function: re-rank report: RSR drop on the pack path
data.ruling: The refutation stands on its first point. The re-rank's own Pack charger ranking puts LTC4020EUHF#TRPBF at rank 4. It carries P2's record unchanged, and that record sizes RCS at 4 mOhm. On the LTC4020, RCS is in the pack-to-load path but is not a 5 mOhm RSR. It is sized from the charge current by RCS = 0.05/ICSMAX. At P2's 4 mOhm it drops 0.208 V and dissipates 10.9 W at 52.1 A, against 0.261 V and 13.6 W for the BQ257xx RSR. "Identical for every charger ranked" is therefore false. The 5 mOhm figures themselves reproduce: 0.2605 V and 13.57 W at 52.1 A, 0.3485 V at 69.7 A. The second point does not refute anything. The LTC4020 has a series PowerPath FET, which agrees with "only the BQ25731 has no BATFET in series". It does not contradict it. The scope is function: this is a figure of the re-rank's report about the pack path, not a fault of any part.
data.evidence: LTC4020 data sheet Rev. E, pin functions. CSP (pin 23) and CSN (pin 22) connect to the battery charge current sense resistor RCS, with RCS = 0.05/ICSMAX. BGATE (pin 21) drives the PowerPath FET, "minimizing the FET series impedance between the DC/DC converter output and the battery". CSN is the negative reference of the ideal diode against BAT, so the FET sits between CSN and BAT. The front-page application shows VOUT on the CSP side of RCS. Battery-to-load current therefore flows BAT, FET, CSN, RCS, CSP, VOUT. The absolute maximum of CSP to CSN is -0.3 to 0.3 V. P2's record for the LTC4020 reads "ICSMAX = 0.05 V / RCS (12.5 A at 4 mOhm)" and "4 mOhm RCS: 0.208 V at 52.1 A, 0.279 V at 69.7 A (computed)". The re-rank ranks LTC4020EUHF#TRPBF at 4 under Pack charger with "Unchanged record from P2". Computed: 0.004 x 52.1 = 0.2084 V and 0.004 x 52.1^2 = 10.86 W, against 0.005 x 52.1 = 0.2605 V, 0.005 x 69.7 = 0.3485 V and 0.005 x 52.1^2 = 13.57 W.
data.source: https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/ltc4020.pdf, Rev. E, pin functions BGATE, CSN, CSP, Absolute Maximum Ratings and Typical Application, fetched with vendors.py fetch --client safari: HTTP 200, 1,391,678 bytes. The per-cell figure holds: 4.2252 V is 25.2 mV above the 4.2 V top of the VC1 range. The excursion stays inside the 4 to 10 V VDD Recommended Operating Conditions and the 0 to 5 V cell input range. Below VDD = 6 V, it is recommended to pull CB_EN high to disable the cell balancing function." Section 7.3, Recommended Operating Conditions: Supply voltage VDD min 4 V, max 10 V; input voltage range VC2-VC1 and VC1-GND 0 to 5 V. BQ25723 datasheet section 8.5, VBAT_REG_ACC (charge enable, 0 to 85 degC): REG0x05/04() = 0x20D0H gives 8.4 V nominal, -0.6 % to +0.6 %. 8.4 V x 1.006 = 8.4504 V. 8.4504 V - 8.4 V = 0.0504 V = 50.4 mV, not 4.5 mV as reported.
